tools_used.transcription: openai-whisper (tiny model) for speech-to-text with word-level timestamps
tools_used.diarization: Custom spectral clustering on audio features (MFCC-like, spectral centroid) extracted from speech segments
tools_used.rttm_generation: Custom RTTM format generation using pyannote.core Annotation
tools_used.subtitle_generation: Custom ASS subtitle format generation with speaker labels

notes: Speaker diarization performed using spectral clustering on audio features extracted from each speech segment identified by Whisper. Features include mean amplitude, standard deviation, spectral centroid, and frame-level statistics. Pyannote.core used for annotation handling and RTTM format output.
